description: Paper market-data quality preflight gate before M133/M135/M136 scheduler execution.
required_behavior: Evaluate fill_marks_json and loop_marks_jsons before scheduler execution when the session/calendar gate allows the tick.
Block paper scheduler execution when required marks are missing, delayed data is not allowed, or snapshots/ticks are stale beyond configured thresholds.
Expose preflight status in watch tick, runner, daemon, Markdown, and JSON outputs.
Keep the gate paper-only: it reads existing snapshot JSON files and does not request market data or submit/transmit orders.
